title: REQ · Suggest What Happens Next sheet submits prompts and shows history
summary: Contribution sheet submits via API, shows remaining count, Round-close note, history, error states
description: Context: no contribution UI exists. Desired behavior: a Suggest What Happens Next button in the playing view opens a sheet with a textarea; submit creates an anonymous session if needed then POSTs the prompt; the sheet shows remaining contributions, a note that ideas are considered when the Round closes, and history with sending, sent and failed states. Expected result: errors from 401/409/429 show readable messages. Why: players steer the next release.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet is open, when a prompt is submitted, then fetch POST /api/v1/contributions receives world_id and prompt and the history lists it as sent
Given the API answers 429 or 409, then the sheet shows an error message and the history entry is failed
Given the sheet, then the text 'considered when the Round closes' and the remaining count are visible
Given a 401 on submit, then a session is created via POST /api/v1/player/session and the submit is retried once
technical_constraints: Remaining = MAX_PER_PLAYER constant (5) minus history length since the API exposes no count
definition_of_done: Sheet usable from the playing view
